newVisitor.heading: Learn American English one sound at a time.
newVisitor.intro: Start with vowels and consonants and work up to contractions, intonation and fast speech, with notes in Spanish and English.

sounds.question: I already know grammar. Why start with sounds?
sounds.answer: Because you can't understand a word you can't hear. Each course assumes the sounds from the one before it, so the Basic Course gives your ear what fast speech will later demand.

time.question: What if I only have a few minutes a day?
time.answer: Every sound is its own video, so one sitting is one idea. Stop anywhere — the home page brings you back to the exact second you left.

phone.question: Can I practice from my phone?
phone.answer: Yes. Add it to your home screen and it opens like an app, in English, Spanish or Portuguese.

AddToHomeScreenGuide.label: Keep the course one tap away
AddToHomeScreenGuide.payoff: Add it to your home screen and it opens like an app — no hunting for the tab.
AddToHomeScreenGuide.stepMore: Tap “···” in the bottom bar, to the right of the address.
AddToHomeScreenGuide.stepShare: Choose “Share”, the first item in the menu.
AddToHomeScreenGuide.stepViewMore: The sheet opens half-way. Tap “View More”, at the end of the row, to open it out.
AddToHomeScreenGuide.stepAddToHomeScreen: In the list that appears, choose “Add to Home Screen”.
AddToHomeScreenGuide.stepAdd: Tap “Add”. Leave “Open as Web App” switched on.
AddToHomeScreenGuide.result: Done — the course now sits on your home screen, like any other app.
